title: Build with dumbells
author: Marta B.
desc:
I designed this program for people who want to Strength train but are limited on time and equipment.

If you want to work out from home, this is for you.
You'll just need some dumbells, no overcomplicated moves.

The program is designed so that you'll repeat the same exercises over 4 weeks in order to master form and add weight progressively.

That's how you'll see results!

ss.note: 8 reps on each side for 3 sets

ex.note: 8 reps on each side for 3 sets
8 reps on each side for 3 sets
8 reps on each side for 3 sets
6 reps on each side for 3 sets
Repeat prescribed reps on each side for 3 sets

Make this your heaviest lift
If unable to add weight play with tempo (down for 3 secs up in 1 sec)
If unable to do push ups replace with floor or bench press
Use a dumbell if kettlebell is unavailable
